part.text:
Refactor complete. The SSG now uses a plugin system while preserving identical external behavior.

**What changed:**
- `src/plugin.ts` — `Plugin` interface (`onStart`, `beforeBuild`, `afterBuild`, `onFile`, `onEnd`) + `PluginContext` + hook runners.
- `src/plugins/markdown.ts` — `MarkdownPlugin` (file reading, frontmatter, `marked` → HTML).
- `src/plugins/template.ts` — `TemplatePlugin` (Handlebars/layout rendering + built-in fallback renderer + index generation).
- `src/plugins/dev-server.ts` — `DevServerPlugin` (live-reload server, `injectLiveReloadScript`, `LIVE_RELOAD_PATH`).
- `src/config.ts` — loads plugins from `ssg.config.ts` (also `.js`/`.json`); built-ins always load first.
- `src/engine.ts` — core engine orchestrating the pipeline.
- `src/ssg.ts`, `src/server.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/types.ts` — re-export/back-compat shims so `build`, `startDevServer`, etc. remain unchanged.

All 39 original tests still pass, plus 4 new plugin tests.
